scenes.say: Cinco armas apontadas pra sua cara. E o Caramelo... abanando o rabo. Dia oito.
scenes.prompt: Night on a rooftop terrace, comedic tense moment: several stick figure men in dark tactical vests and caps point shotguns and flashlights down at the stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat and the stick figure girl Bia with the red bandana, who raise their hands; in the middle, the caramel mutt dog with the red collar happily wags its tail and sniffs a guard's boot, little heart above it.

scenes.say: Os homens baixam as armas. O Coronel quer ver vocês.
scenes.prompt: Night rooftop: a stick figure guard in a dark tactical vest and cap lowers his shotgun and speaks into a walkie-talkie, other guards lowering their weapons behind him. In the foreground, the stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat and the stick figure girl Bia with the red bandana slowly lower their hands, wary.

scenes.say: Eles levam vocês até um lugar que você conhece: o shopping do bairro. Só que agora... é uma fortaleza.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot at dusk of a Brazilian neighborhood shopping mall turned into a fortress: a wall of stacked cars and buses around the parking lot, barbed wire, watchtowers made of scaffolding with spotlights, armed stick figure guards on the roof, and warm electric lights glowing inside the mall. Outside the walls, scattered green-headed zombies wander. Small group of stick figures walking toward the gate.

scenes.say: Muro de carros, arame farpado, gente armada no estacionamento. E lá dentro: luz! Gerador funcionando.
scenes.prompt: Inside the fortified shopping mall entrance: bright electric lights, a big diesel generator running with a cable mess, survivors (stick figures) working, carrying boxes, a guard with a rifle. The stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat, the stick figure girl Bia with the red bandana and the caramel mutt dog look around amazed, light reflecting in their eyes.

scenes.say: O Coronel tá na praça de alimentação. Boina verde, óculos escuros, bigode.
scenes.prompt: The food court of the shopping mall: the Coronel from the reference sheet (stick figure with a dark green beret, black aviator sunglasses, thick black mustache, olive tactical vest, toothpick in his mouth) sits on a plastic food court chair placed on top of a table like a throne, legs crossed, two armed guards at his sides. Closed fast-food counters behind him. Low angle, imposing.

scenes.say: E ele só tem uma regra: aqui, quem não trabalha, não come. Se você quer saber se vale a pena ficar, segue o perfil: faltam vinte e dois dias.
scenes.prompt: Close shot of the Coronel from the reference sheet (dark green beret, black aviator sunglasses, thick black mustache, toothpick) pointing his finger at the viewer with a smug grin. Behind him, on the food court wall, a big hand-painted red slogan reads exactly 'QUEM NÃO TRABALHA NÃO COME'.

scenes.say: Vocês ganham um colchão na loja de móveis e o primeiro prato de comida quente em uma semana.
scenes.prompt: Inside a furniture store in the mall, warm light: the stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat and the stick figure girl Bia with the red bandana sit on a mattress on the floor happily eating big plates of rice and beans with a fork, steam rising, the caramel mutt dog eating from a bowl next to them. Display sofas and lamps around.

scenes.say: Pela primeira vez, você dorme tranquilo. Mas a Bia não.
scenes.prompt: Night in the dark furniture store of the mall: the stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat sleeps peacefully on the mattress hugging the caramel mutt dog, a 'Z' above him. Next to him, the stick figure girl Bia with the red bandana sits up awake, worried, staring into the dark mall corridor outside the store.

scenes.say: De madrugada, ela te acorda: escuta. Do fundo do shopping, de uma sala trancada com corrente... batidas.
scenes.prompt: The far end of a dark shopping mall service corridor at night: a grey metal double door marked 'SOMENTE FUNCIONÁRIOS' is locked with a heavy chain and a big padlock, and the door is dented and bulging outward from impacts inside. In the foreground, the silhouettes of the stick figure girl Bia with the red bandana and the stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat hold a flashlight pointed at the door.
scenes.video_prompt: Animate this flat 2D cartoon illustration: the chained metal double door jolts and bulges outward again and again from blows inside, the heavy chain and padlock rattle and swing, dust falls from the door frame, the flashlight beam trembles in the scared hands. Keep the exact flat 2D cartoon style, bold outlines and colors. No morphing, no new text.

scenes.say: Comenta: o que tem na sala?
